newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Profit-taking puts dampener on South African gold stocks.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking puts dampener on South African gold stocks.

text.p: South African gold shares ended slightly firmer but some profit-taking and a strong rand put a lid on them rising further late on Monday, dealers said.
Towards the close of trade the bullion price had recovered a dollar up from most of the day's $352 level.
The all-share index pushed to new all-time closing highs.

The dealers said overall sentiment was positive in quiet Monday trading. They said the market was still awaiting some direction before the March 12 budget to be presented by Finance Minister Trevor Manuel. But dealers said his pre-budget roadshow was positive.
Dealers said further gains could be expected within the next one or two days on the industrials side provided currency gains held.
They added that there had been little effect from Wall Street on the local market on Monday.
